resources.string: Automatic hotspot joining (experimental)

Optional repair for supported firmware with Android 13+ and a 5 GHz-only car hotspot. Check prepares a private rollback backup without changing the hotspot. Requires authorized local ADB on localhost:5555; TLS wireless-debugging pairing is not supported.
Check hotspot repair
Add automatic-join information
Restore saved hotspot
Checking or updating… Cancellation may need a fresh check to verify the outcome.

While parked, disconnect CarPlay and turn the hotspot off in car settings first. This action changes only the saved hotspot configuration and verifies readback. Turn the hotspot back on yourself afterward to update its broadcasts. Existing clients will disconnect when you turn it off. Keep the private backup for rollback.
Disconnect CarPlay before changing the hotspot.
Supported 5 GHz configuration. Private full backup prepared; no hotspot change yet.
The tested information is already present. No duplicate added; DiPlay has no rollback ownership of an existing element.
Saved configuration verified. Turn the hotspot on in car settings to update broadcasts, then test automatic joining. Broadcast and CarPlay success still require a device test.
Full saved configuration restored and verified. Turn the hotspot on in car settings.
Unsupported API, firmware, band or conflicting vendor information. No repair applied. Use a supported 5 GHz-only configuration; other bands are unverified.
Hotspot must be confirmed off. Disconnect clients and turn it off in car settings, then retry. DiPlay will not restart it automatically.
Configuration changed since the backup. Nothing overwritten. Check again; an outstanding rollback backup is retained.
Firmware changed. The private backup is retained but cannot safely be restored on this firmware.
Cancelled before writing. Check again to inspect any retained rollback state.
Repair failed or was cancelled after writing. Original configuration restored and readback verified.
Another hotspot operation is still running. Wait, then check again.
Requires approved plain local ADB on localhost:5555. Enable and authorize it using your supported car setup. Android TLS wireless-debugging pairing alone will not work.

Outcome or backup verification is uncertain. Turn the hotspot off and check again before continuing. An existing private backup is retained; restore is allowed only when the configuration still matches.
